description: In a PA model in the fixed ambient universe, for arbitrary internal values \(m,n\), the actual addition builder returns an accepted certificate for \(\overline m+\overline n=\overline{m+n}\), with the numeral and sentence codes computed internally.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.NumericalProofs.certified_additionBuilder {M : Type}
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA]
  (m n : M) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.Certified
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.axiomVerifier
    (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.NumericalProofs.additionBuilder.value ![m, n])
    (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.modelNode 4
      [Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.NumericalProofs.additionSyntax
          (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.NumericalProofs.numeralSyntax m)
          (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.NumericalProofs.numeralSyntax n),
        Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.NumericalProofs.numeralSyntax
          (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.addValue M m n)])
